contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN CONS[---] ; R/ [FEL TEMP RE]PAR[ATIO

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Lyons mint, Reece period 18. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN CONS[---]. Reverse description: Soldier advancing right spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP RE]PAR[ATIO. In exergue: PLG. Diameter: 15mm, Weight: 1.12gms, die axis: 6
